8 اعتقّ السَّحَابُ The clouds became rent, (K, TA,) and their water poured forth. (TA.) See also 1, first quarter. [And see 7.] ＝
-A2- اعتقّ السَّيْفَ He drew the sword (O, K) from its scabbard. (O.) ＝
-A3- And اعتقّ [probably from عَقَّ بِالسَّهْمِ, q. v.,] He exceeded the due bounds, or was immoderate, in excusing himself. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
